name: Prashar Lake Kishna Camp
signature_dish: home-cooked dal-chawal-sabzi camp dinner with bonfire pakoras
why_it_matters: Run by Krishna ("Kishna"), this is the highest-rated camp at Prashar Lake — #1 of 5 Mandi campsites on TripAdvisor (4.7/5, Travellers' Choice). The main camp sits roughly 2 km from the lake; the operator also runs Kishna Cafe in Baggi village (the trek trailhead), where most groups stop for hot showers and pancakes before climbing. Food is included in the camp package — there are no standalone restaurants at the lake itself.
insider_tip: Book the camp meals in advance — once you're at 2,730m there's no walk-in option and the kitchen plans portions for confirmed guests only. The Baggi cafe is the only realistic breakfast stop on the drive in from Mandi.
signature_address: Prashar Lake / Baggi village, Mandi District, Himachal Pradesh

name: Fogg Hill Camping Parashar Lake
signature_dish: package camp meals (breakfast / lunch / dinner / evening tea / bonfire snacks)
why_it_matters: Run by "Raj bhai" — ranked #2 of 5 Mandi campgrounds on TripAdvisor (4.8/5 over 24 reviews). About a 5-minute drive from the lake. Food is package-bundled with the tent, not à la carte; reviewers consistently flag generous portions ("5 meals when 3 were promised") and on-time service. There is no separate cafe — meals are served at the camp.
insider_tip: If you're vegetarian-flexible, no issue; the kitchen cooks one menu for the whole camp. Confirm meal count when booking — packages vary between 3 and 5 servings per night.
signature_address: Prashar Lake, Mandi District, Himachal Pradesh
